arguments.prompt: Create ONE transparent Cartoon game sprite. Image1 is this exact original's pose/action/geometry authority. Image2 is the established adult mermaid identity and drawing style ONLY; do not copy its pose, hand gesture or profile if image1 differs. Same adult woman with very long golden blonde hair, turquoise headband, tan skin, modest green bikini top, crisp dark outlines, clean restrained cel shading. Red/white source stippling means normal tan skin, never checkered clothing. Required pose: A VERY LOW wide partly submerged pose. Head and long hair lie nearly horizontal at the surface, face mostly hidden down into hair/water, turquoise headband visible on the left portion of the hair. A small tan bent arm fragment is visible at lower-center as original; preserve its attachment under hair, do not expose a full face or complete extra torso. Hair spreads left and right with thin cyan/white horizontal water strokes crossing in front. Match original low flattened silhouette, no upright head/shoulders. Trace each arm from shoulder through elbow to hand; hide the parts occluded by hair/body. Preserve visible waterline-only body framing: no tail, legs or extra lower body. Thin attached pale-cyan/white ripple strokes immediately beneath body/hair as original, not dark puddles or thick foam. Genuine transparent RGBA, generous clear padding around complete hair, hands and ripples. No scenery, floor, cast shadow, halo/glow, labels or props.
